description: Síntese das Zonas de Risco no Vale do Taquari is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O mapeamento síntese de Zonas de Risco apresenta o resultado das áreas suscetíveis a inundações, zonas preliminares de arraste e movimentos de massa. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Downloadable Data, Zonas de Risco, Suscetibilidade à Inundação, Zonas de Arraste, Movimentos de Massa. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
